_doc: Body Backstage season 1 reboot, look test only ('live scan'). The channel's theme.json is untouched until the owner approves this look. Abyss teal-black ground (the surgical green taken darker and filmic), photoreal tissue, blood red, and the channel's chartreuse kept as the instrument (scan line, reticles, readouts). Type: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (titles 800, captions 700) and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono (the instrument's readouts); Fraunces retires with the old look.
